gizmo.title: Hoʻomaka mea hana o waho
gizmo.description: He poloka e wehe ana i kekahi mea hana aʻo o waho ma kahi pukaaniani hou a i ʻole ma ka ʻaoʻao, ma ke ʻano he loulou maʻalahi a i ʻole me kahi noi komo LTI 1.3.

configure.title: Poʻo inoa
configure.description: Inoa o ka mea hana. Hōʻike ʻia ma ke poʻo a ma ke pihi.

configure.title: Wehewehe
configure.description: Ka mea a nā haumāna e hana ai ma ka mea hana, hōʻike ʻia ma luna o ke pihi.

configure.title: URL hoʻomaka
configure.description: Helu wahi o ka mea hana. Pono he helu wahi piha e hoʻomaka ana me https:// a i ʻole http://.

configure.title: Wehe ma
configure.description: Hana ka pukaaniani hou me nā mea hana a pau. Hana ʻo Ma kēia ʻaoʻao me nā mea hana e ʻae ana e hōʻike ʻia i loko o kekahi kahua ʻē aʻe wale nō.

advanced.title: URL komo LTI
advanced.description: LTI 1.3 wale nō: ka helu wahi hoʻomaka komo o ka mea hana. Me kēia, he client ID a me he deployment ID, hoʻouna ke pihi i kahi noi komo LTI ma kahi o ka wehe ʻana i kahi loulou maʻalahi. Pono ka lawelawe LTI o kēia kahua e hoʻopau i ka hoʻomaka ʻana.

advanced.title: LTI client ID
advanced.description: Ka client ID a ka mea hana i hāʻawi ai i kēia kahua. He mea hōʻike lehulehu, ʻaʻole he huna: mai kau loa i nā kī a i ʻole nā huna ma ʻaneʻi.

advanced.title: LTI deployment ID
advanced.description: Ka deployment ID a ka mea hana i hāʻawi ai i kēia kahua. He mea hōʻike lehulehu, ʻaʻole he huna.

advanced.title: LTI issuer
advanced.description: Ka helu wahi e hōʻike ana i kēia kahua i ka mea hana. E waiho hakahaka e hoʻohana i ka helu wahi o ke kahua e noho ai ka ʻaoʻao.

advanced.title: Kiʻekiʻe ma ka ʻaoʻao
advanced.description: Kiʻekiʻe o ka mea hana ke wehe ʻia ma kēia ʻaoʻao, ma nā pika (200 a i 2000).

advanced.title: Waihoʻoluʻu koʻikoʻi
advanced.description: Waihoʻoluʻu o ka ʻāpana poʻo a me ke pihi. E waiho hakahaka e ukali i ke kumuhana.

developer.title: Kuhi komo LTI
developer.description: He waiwai pōhihi e hoʻohana ai ka lawelawe LTI o kēia kahua e ʻike i ka haumāna. Hāʻawi pinepine ʻia e ke kahua ma o ka hanana lti-launch-request ma kahi o ka mālama ʻia ma ʻaneʻi. ʻAʻole loa he ʻōlelo huna a i ʻole kī.

developer.title: Kuhi memo LTI
developer.description: He waiwai pōhihi e hoʻohana ai ka lawelawe LTI o kēia kahua e ʻike i kēia hoʻomaka ʻana. Hāʻawi pinepine ʻia e ke kahua ma kahi o ka mālama ʻia ma ʻaneʻi.
